description: Only films with a replacement cost above 20.99 are included. A cost of exactly 20.99 is left out.

d.request: For films with `replacement_cost` greater than 20.99, calculate the average of `rental_rate / rental_duration` for each rating, ignoring missing values; calculate the simple mean of the non-missing rating averages; if it exists, list ratings whose average is strictly above it, with each rating, its average, and its difference above the overall mean, all unrounded.
d.sql:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS mean_rating_average
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT ra.rating,
       ra.avg_rate_per_day,
       ra.avg_rate_per_day - om.mean_rating_average AS difference_above_mean
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ra.avg_rate_per_day > om.mean_rating_average;

b.request: Filter films to those with `replacement_cost` > 20.99; for each rating, compute the average of `rental_rate / rental_duration`, ignoring missing values, then compute the unweighted mean of the nonmissing rating averages. If that mean exists, list ratings whose average is strictly greater than it, with each rating’s average and its difference above the mean, all unrounded.
b.sql:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS mean_rating_average
  FROM rating_averages
  WHERE avg_rate_per_day IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ra.rating,
       ra.avg_rate_per_day,
       ra.avg_rate_per_day - om.mean_rating_average AS difference_above_mean
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ra.avg_rate_per_day IS NOT NULL
  AND om.mean_rating_average IS NOT NULL
  AND ra.avg_rate_per_day > om.mean_rating_average;

a.request: Among films whose replacement cost is more than 20.99, compute for each rating the average of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` (ignoring missing values). Then take the simple mean of these per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that overall mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and how far its average is above the overall mean (all unrounded).
a.sql:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS mean_rating_average
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT ra.rating,
       ra.avg_rate_per_day AS average,
       ra.avg_rate_per_day - oa.mean_rating_average AS above_overall_mean
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE ra.avg_rate_per_day > oa.mean_rating_average;

c.request: Using 20.99 as the replacement-cost cutoff for films, compute for each rating the average of `rental_rate` divided by `rental_duration` over the qualifying films (ignoring missing values). Then take the simple mean of these per-rating averages, ignoring missing ones. If that overall mean exists, list each rating whose average is strictly greater than it, showing the rating, its average, and how far its average is above the overall mean (all unrounded). Only films with a replacement cost above 20.99 are included. A cost of exactly 20.99 is left out.
c.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS mean_of_averages FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_rate_per_day, ra.avg_rate_per_day - oa.mean_of_averages AS above_overall_mean FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE oa.mean_of_averages IS NOT NULL AND ra.avg_rate_per_day > oa.mean_of_averages
